Animator.move.description: Configure a StateAnimation target. Set the target position; when an anchor is supplied, offset the target so that bounds point reaches it.

parameters.target: Target coordinate for the transform, in world units in its parent coordinate space.
parameters.anchor: A local bounds coordinate such as CENTER, UP or [-1,1,0], or an explicit TransformOption. A pivot names a world point; an anchor resolves from geometry.

Animator.move.returnsDescription: The same Animator builder for chaining.
notes: Pass the returned builder to Scene.play; this call does not schedule playback.
Changing the pivot can synchronize the live entity offset during builder setup.

Animator.shift.description: Configure a StateAnimation target. Translate the target relative to its current target transform along local/parent axes.

parameters.p: Translation delta in world units; parent rotation/scale affects the resulting world motion.
parameters.anchor: A local bounds coordinate such as CENTER, UP or [-1,1,0], or an explicit TransformOption. A pivot names a world point; an anchor resolves from geometry.

Animator.shift.returnsDescription: The same Animator builder for chaining.
notes: Pass the returned builder to Scene.play; this call does not schedule playback.
Changing the pivot can synchronize the live entity offset during builder setup.

Animator.shiftWorld.description: Configure a StateAnimation target. Translate the target along world axes, accounting for the parent transform.

parameters.p: World-space displacement vector in scene units.

Animator.shiftWorld.returnsDescription: The same Animator builder for chaining.
notes: Pass the returned builder to Scene.play; this call does not schedule playback.

Animator.setScale.description: Configure a StateAnimation target. Replace the target scale with an absolute scalar or per-axis scale.

parameters.scale: Absolute scale; one scalar applies to all axes. It is not a multiplier.
parameters.anchor: A local bounds coordinate such as CENTER, UP or [-1,1,0], or an explicit TransformOption. A pivot names a world point; an anchor resolves from geometry.

Animator.setScale.returnsDescription: The same Animator builder for chaining.

Changing the pivot can synchronize the live entity offset during builder setup.

GroupAnimator.move.description: Configure the target states of all group members. Set the target position; when an anchor is supplied, offset the target so that bounds point reaches it.

parameters.position: Coordinate applied to each member target; this can bring members to the same position.
parameters.options: A local bounds coordinate such as CENTER, UP or [-1,1,0], or an explicit TransformOption. A pivot names a world point; an anchor resolves from geometry.

GroupAnimator.move.returnsDescription: The same GroupAnimator builder for chaining.
notes: Pass the returned builder to Scene.play; this call does not schedule playback.
All members receive the destination. Use shift to preserve their relative placement.
Pivot/anchor setup can synchronize live offsets to preserve placement. Group rotate/scale anchors use combined target bounds.

Animator.pause.description: Pause the remembered played animation without removing it or resolving its promise.
Animator.pause.returnsDescription: No value. Before getAnim/play has established an active animation, this has no effect.

Animator.resume.description: Resume the remembered paused animation at its current elapsed time.
Animator.resume.returnsDescription: No value; no new animation is created.

GroupAnimator.constructor.description: Snapshot each member’s current state and construct one target StateAnimation per member.

parameters.entities: Entities to animate; this collection does not create a scene-graph parent.
parameters.lagRatio: Relative child start stagger, not milliseconds; zero starts together.
parameters.options: Timing/easing options applied to each child.

notes: Build near the intended play so its start states are current.

GroupAnimator.getAnim.description: Wrap the configured child state animations in a Concurrent scheduler.
GroupAnimator.getAnim.returnsDescription: A new Concurrent wrapper using the existing child animations and group lag/options; not a deep copy of the members.

SceneComposer.remove.description: Detach a scene from this composer’s render stack and destroy its InteractionManager.

parameters.scene: Registered scene to detach; unknown scenes leave the stack unchanged.

notes: This does not destroy its entities or the whole composer. The scene composer reference becomes null; its external owner must decide whether to reuse or destroy it.

SceneComposer.destroy.description: Pause the composer, destroy entities in all registered scenes, clear the stack, destroy owned controls/recorder, drain deferred releases and release the view buffer.
notes: This is shutdown for the whole composer. The canvas window-resize listener is removed. Do not call it to retire just one composed scene.

Entity.removeComponent.description: Remove an attached component instance, update optimized component references/lists, clear its entity reference, and call its onDestroy hook.

parameters.component: The attached instance to remove; null and absent components are ignored.

Entity.removeComponent.returnsDescription: True when the instance was removed, false otherwise.
notes: Cleanup cannot rely on component.entity because that reference is cleared before the hook.

Component.update.description: Advance a custom behavior attached to an entity.

parameters.t: Absolute running scene time in milliseconds.
parameters.dt: Elapsed scene delta in milliseconds; divide by 1000 for per-second velocities.

notes: Only enabled components with an overridden update are included in the optimized entity update list. Continuous motion also needs the composer to advance frames.

Component.onInit.description: Initialize attachment-owned behavior after Entity.addComponent assigns entity.
notes: The entity need not already belong to a scene. Do not assume a GPU device or canvas is available unless supplied by the owner.

Component.onDestroy.description: Release resources and subscriptions owned by this component.
notes: Make cleanup idempotent and store needed references locally; removeComponent clears entity before invoking this hook. Shared resources should be retired by their shared owner.

Text.setText.description: Replace the stored string and rebuild vector glyph geometry.

parameters.text: Replacement string, including line breaks supported by the selected font/layout.

notes: The parent survives, but old glyph child references can be destroyed. Reacquire characters after a rebuild, then remeasure/rearrange dependent layout.

Text.getChar.description: Decompose merged text if necessary, then retrieve a character slot.

parameters.index: Zero-based character-slot index. Whitespace/newline slots can have no drawable entity.

Text.getChar.returnsDescription: The glyph child or null for an empty/out-of-range slot.
notes: The returned child is live owned geometry, not a copy. Rebuilds can invalidate this reference. The editing implementation is not a general Unicode grapheme editor.

Text.setChar.description: Replace a single character, update its geometry and reflow later glyph positions.

parameters.index: Zero-based index in the current string. Invalid indices are ignored.
parameters.newChar: A string of length one; other lengths are ignored.

notes: Replacing a visible glyph with whitespace can remove/destroy its child. Complex Unicode characters may span more than one string code unit; do not assume grapheme-safe indexing.

Text.insert.description: Insert a one-character string and update subsequent glyph layout.

parameters.index: Insertion index; follows the implementation’s array splice behavior.
parameters.char: A one-character string; other lengths are ignored.

Text.delete.description: Remove the character at the supplied index and reflow later slots.

parameters.index: Zero-based current-string index; invalid indices leave text unchanged.

Text.getGroupAnimator.description: Build a GroupAnimator from the currently available non-null character entities.

parameters.staggerMs: Passed directly as GroupAnimator lagRatio despite its legacy name; it is not converted from milliseconds.

Text.getGroupAnimator.returnsDescription: A GroupAnimator of the existing character children.
notes: Decompose first when animating individual glyphs. The legacy default 100 is passed as a ratio, so supply a deliberate small ratio rather than assuming a 100 ms gap.

parameters.text: Replacement string, including line breaks supported by the selected font/layout.

notes: The parent survives, but old glyph child references can be destroyed. Reacquire characters after a rebuild, then remeasure/rearrange dependent layout.

Code.highlightLine.description: Replace the current line highlight with a rectangle behind the requested line.

parameters.lineNum: Displayed line number, respecting startLineNumber; invalid lines return null.
parameters.color: Optional annotation color; the method supplies its own default.

Code.highlightLine.returnsDescription: The created annotation entity, or null for an invalid line.

Code.markDeletedLine.description: Add a deletion marker on the requested displayed line.

parameters.lineNum: Displayed line number, respecting startLineNumber; invalid lines return null.
parameters.color: Optional annotation color; the method supplies its own default.

Code.markDeletedLine.returnsDescription: The created annotation entity, or null for an invalid line.

Code.showErrorLine.description: Add an error marker at the requested displayed line.

parameters.lineNum: Displayed line number, respecting startLineNumber; invalid lines return null.
parameters.color: Optional annotation color; the method supplies its own default.

Code.showErrorLine.returnsDescription: The created annotation entity, or null for an invalid line.

Code.addTooltip.description: Attach a tooltip annotation to the requested displayed line.

parameters.lineNum: Displayed line number, respecting startLineNumber; invalid lines return null.
parameters.content: Tooltip text rendered as a child annotation.
parameters.color: Optional annotation color; the method supplies its own default.

Code.addTooltip.returnsDescription: The created annotation entity, or null for an invalid line.

Code.highlightText.description: Find and annotate one occurrence of a substring in the current code.
Code.highlightText.returnsDescription: The created annotation or null when the requested match is not found.

Code.markDeletedText.description: Find and annotate one occurrence of a substring in the current code.
Code.markDeletedText.returnsDescription: The created annotation or null when the requested match is not found.

Code.showErrorText.description: Find and annotate one occurrence of a substring in the current code.
Code.showErrorText.returnsDescription: The created annotation or null when the requested match is not found.

Code.highlightBlock.description: Add a background highlight spanning displayed lines.

Code.highlightBlock.returnsDescription: The created rectangle or null if the range is invalid.

Code.addCursor.description: Add a cursor rectangle at a displayed line and character column.

FrameGraph.addPass.description: Append a Pass instance to the graph definition.

parameters.pass: Pass whose setup declares dependencies and whose execute encodes GPU work.

FrameGraph.addPass.returnsDescription: No value; compile before executing the changed graph.

FrameGraph.compile.description: Run pass setup, resolve resource versions, keep sinks and their producers, topologically order them and calculate lifetimes.
FrameGraph.compile.returnsDescription: No value; cyclic dependencies throw an Error.

FrameGraph.reset.description: Clear the resource pool and all virtual resources, passes and compiled order.
FrameGraph.reset.returnsDescription: No value; old handles no longer identify resources in this graph.

FrameGraph.aliasTexture.description: Create a new virtual version of a texture rooted in the same physical resource.

parameters.creator: Pass that produces the new version.

FrameGraph.aliasTexture.returnsDescription: New TextureHandle; this does not allocate a separate GPU texture.

FrameGraph.aliasBuffer.description: Create a new virtual version of a buffer rooted in the same physical resource.

parameters.creator: Pass that produces the new version.

FrameGraph.aliasBuffer.returnsDescription: New BufferHandle; this does not allocate a separate GPU buffer.

FrameGraph.importPersistentTexture.description: Import an already allocated texture as an externally supplied persistent graph resource.

parameters.texture: GPUTexture that must outlive all graph uses.
parameters.handle: Optional existing handle to populate; omitted creates one.

FrameGraph.updatePersistentTexture.description: Replace the physical texture on the imported root and clear its cached default view.

parameters.handle: Handle belonging to the persistent texture root.
parameters.texture: New GPUTexture with the format/usage required by consuming passes.

FrameGraph.updatePersistentTexture.returnsDescription: No value; retire the previous external texture only after its last use.

FrameGraph.importPersistentBuffer.description: Import an already allocated buffer as a persistent graph resource.

parameters.buffer: GPUBuffer owned externally and kept alive through graph use.
parameters.handle: Optional handle to populate; omitted creates one.

GraphBuilder.markUnculled.description: Mark this pass as an active sink even when no other pass reads its output.
GraphBuilder.markUnculled.returnsDescription: No value; its declared producers are retained with it.

PostProcessPass.getDefaultShader.description: Wrap fragment logic in the built-in fullscreen sampling shader.

parameters.fragmentMain: WGSL body using sampled color, uv and view; it must return a vec4f.

PostProcessPass.getDefaultShader.returnsDescription: Complete WGSL module string with fullscreen vertex entry and resource declarations.

PostProcessPass.constructor.description: Create a sampled fullscreen effect with an input handle and a new output/presentation handle.

parameters.name: Pass label used in graph/debugging.
parameters.input: TextureHandle of the image produced by an earlier pass.

UniformSchema.constructor.description: Compute aligned field byte offsets and rounded allocation size for a uniform struct.

parameters.layout: Ordered field map of DataType values or nested UniformSchema instances.

UniformSchema.getFlatOffset.description: Resolve a field or nested dot path to its byte offset in the root allocation.

parameters.path: Field name or nested path such as light.color.

UniformSchema.getFlatOffset.returnsDescription: Byte offset, not Float32Array index; unknown or non-nested paths throw.

UniformSchema.generateWGSL.description: Emit recursive WGSL struct declarations and optionally a root uniform binding.

parameters.group: Root bind-group index when isRoot is true.
parameters.binding: Root binding index when isRoot is true.
parameters.isRoot: Defaults true; false emits structs without an explicit uniform variable.

UniformSchema.generateWGSL.returnsDescription: WGSL source. Use isRoot=false when a Shader resource schema supplies the binding.

UniformBufferData.set.description: Write floating-point values into the schema’s field offset.

parameters.value: Number or float array to write at that offset; field capacity is not automatically validated.

UniformBufferData.set.returnsDescription: No value; this updates CPU storage, not the GPU buffer. Call queue.writeBuffer separately.

FrameGraph.registerTexture.description: Register a texture resource descriptor for graph allocation.

parameters.handle: Handle populated with the registered virtual-resource index.
parameters.desc: Texture descriptor specifying size, usage and format.
parameters.isPersistent: Keep the virtual allocation across frame lifetimes; default false.
parameters.creator: Pass that produces this resource, used to connect graph dependencies.

FrameGraph.registerTexture.returnsDescription: No value; the supplied handle is updated.
notes: Registering a descriptor alone is not a dependency declaration. Pair it with @create or the pass creation arrays.

FrameGraph.registerBuffer.description: Register a buffer resource descriptor for graph allocation.

parameters.handle: Handle populated with the registered virtual-resource index.
parameters.desc: Buffer descriptor specifying size, usage and byte allocation size.
parameters.isPersistent: Keep the virtual allocation across frame lifetimes; default false.
parameters.creator: Pass that produces this resource, used to connect graph dependencies.

FrameGraph.registerBuffer.returnsDescription: No value; the supplied handle is updated.
notes: Registering a descriptor alone is not a dependency declaration. Pair it with @create or the pass creation arrays.

GraphBuilder.createTexture.returnsDescription: No value; the supplied handle is updated.
notes: Registering a descriptor alone is not a dependency declaration. Pair it with @create or the pass creation arrays.

GraphBuilder.createBuffer.description: Register a buffer resource descriptor for graph allocation.

parameters.handle: Handle populated with the registered virtual-resource index.
parameters.desc: Buffer descriptor specifying size, usage and byte allocation size.

GraphBuilder.createBuffer.returnsDescription: No value; the supplied handle is updated.

Shader.setUniformBuffer.description: Register a named UniformBuffer resource on the procedural fragment.

parameters.name: WGSL resource name referenced by fragment logic.
parameters.wgslType: WGSL uniform/storage type, declared compatibly in userFunctions when custom.
parameters.buffer: Existing GPUBuffer with the required usage and layout; binding does not allocate or own it.

notes: Keep supplied resources alive through their last submitted use; manage cleanup at their allocating owner.

Shader.setStorageBuffer.description: Register a named StorageBuffer resource on the procedural fragment.

parameters.name: WGSL resource name referenced by fragment logic.
parameters.wgslType: WGSL uniform/storage type, declared compatibly in userFunctions when custom.
parameters.buffer: Existing GPUBuffer with the required usage and layout; binding does not allocate or own it.
parameters.access: Storage access mode, default read; must match operations in WGSL.

notes: Keep supplied resources alive through their last submitted use; manage cleanup at their allocating owner.

Shader.setTexture.description: Register a named Texture resource on the procedural fragment.

parameters.name: WGSL resource name referenced by fragment logic.
parameters.view: GPUTextureView with the sample type/dimension required by the binding.

notes: Keep supplied resources alive through their last submitted use; manage cleanup at their allocating owner.

Shader.setSampler.description: Register a named Sampler resource on the procedural fragment.

parameters.name: WGSL resource name referenced by fragment logic.
parameters.sampler: Existing GPUSampler compatible with sampled texture access.

notes: Keep supplied resources alive through their last submitted use; manage cleanup at their allocating owner.

Vec3.constructor.description: Create vector storage from coordinates or an existing source.

parameters.x: Scalar, Vec3, Vec2, number array or Float32Array. Float32Array is referenced directly; Vec3 and number-array inputs are copied. A Vec2 constructor input uses z=1.
parameters.y: Y scalar when x is a number; defaults to zero.
parameters.z: Z scalar when x is a number; defaults to zero.

Vec3.cast.description: Normalize supported vector input to Vec3.

parameters.v: Existing Vec3, Vec2, or array/Float32Array of length two or three.

Vec3.cast.returnsDescription: The same object for Vec3 input; a new vector for other inputs.
notes: Invalid array lengths throw. Editing an existing Vec3 returned by cast edits the original.

Vec3.link.description: Replace vector storage with the supplied typed-array reference.

parameters.data: Float32Array storage to share; mutations are visible to all users of this backing memory.

parameters.dst: Optional destination; pass this to mutate in place or a reusable vector to avoid allocation.

Vec3.add.returnsDescription: The supplied destination or a new Vec3 when it is omitted.
notes: Without dst, this operation leaves the receiver unchanged.
